video.title: AI欧腐《被前任狼王强势占有/Claimed by My Ex-Alpha》
video.desc:
Seven years ago, gifted healer Linther fell in love with Caledor, a rejected Wolf King heir born without a wolf. They completed their mate bond. But when Caledor needed him most, Linther severed their bond and vanished. Shattered and alone, Caledor awakened in rage and became the ruthless ruler of the Darknight Wasteland. Now Linther returns, desperate to save his dying son Eli. But Caledor hasn't forgotten. Believing Linther abandoned him for someone else, he forces Linther to stay by his side. Trapped between lingering desire and bitter resentment, neither can escape the past. Until Eli's bloodline awakens, revealing a truth that will change everything: the child is Caledor's own.
七年前，拥有天赋的治愈师 Linther 爱上了 Caledor——一位生而无狼、被族人放逐的狼王继承人。两人缔结了命定伴侣之约。然而就在 Caledor 最需要他的时刻，Linther 却斩断了伴侣之链，不告而别。支离破碎、孤身一人的 Caledor 在暴怒中觉醒，蜕变为暗夜废土上杀伐决断的冷酷统治者。如今 Linther 为救治重病垂危的儿子 Eli，不得不重新归来。可 Caledor 从未忘记过去——他一直以为 Linther 是为了别人而抛弃自己，于是强行将 Linther 留在身边。两人在挥之不去的欲望与深埋心底的怨恨之间无路可逃，直到 Eli 的血脉之力觉醒，揭开了一个足以颠覆一切的真相：这个孩子，正是 Caledor 的亲生骨肉。
